description: Create authorization checker module for placement executor with AuthorizationResult and check_implementation_approval() function. This is the hook W5 will call before any repository mutation. Produces machine-readable evidence for every authorization check. This feature depends on FEAT-001 (ImplementationApproval model) and produces final W4 gate evidence.
steps: Add AuthorizationResult dataclass with fields: authorized (bool), approval_id (Optional[str]), checked_at (str ISO 8601), failure_reason (Optional[str]), evidence (Dict[str, Any])
Add function: check_implementation_approval(workflow_id: str, candidate_sha256: str, manifest_sha256: str, approvals_store: Dict[str, ImplementationApproval]) -> AuthorizationResult
Function looks up ImplementationApproval by workflow_id in approvals_store
Function returns authorized=False if: approval absent, status != APPROVED, candidate_sha256 mismatch, manifest_sha256 mismatch, expired (if expiry field exists in model)
Function returns authorized=True if: approval exists, status=APPROVED, all hashes match, not expired
Function populates evidence dict with: approval_found (bool), status (str), candidate_hash_match (bool), manifest_hash_match (bool), timestamp (str), workflow_id (str)
Add function: produce_authorization_evidence(result: AuthorizationResult, workflow_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any] that converts to W3-style evidence format
Follow W3 evidence pattern: all evidence fields populated, no empty dicts, ISO 8601 timestamps

Test cases: authorization with valid approval (authorized=True), authorization blocks missing approval, authorization blocks wrong status (PENDING/REJECTED), authorization blocks candidate hash mismatch, authorization blocks manifest hash mismatch, authorization blocks expired approval (if expiry exists), evidence dict populated in all cases

After all W4 features complete: run full test suite, create .agents/tasks/m2-9-w4-evidence.json with W3 pattern (status, commit, test_results, approval_example, authorization_example, transition_verification, architectural_compliance)

Create .agents/tasks/m2-9-w4-gate.json with gate checks: approval_model_non_stub, endpoint_completes_stub, transition_guarded, authorization_hook_created, tests_pass, no_graceful_degradation, no_test_weakening, evidence_populated, commit_exists
Git commit all W4 changes with message 'feat: M2.9 W4 - human implementation approval gate'
Record commit SHA in evidence JSON
acceptance_criteria: app/authorization/approval_checker.py exists with AuthorizationResult dataclass and check_implementation_approval() function
check_implementation_approval() returns AuthorizationResult with authorized=True when valid approval exists
check_implementation_approval() returns authorized=False with failure_reason when approval missing/invalid
Function verifies: approval exists, status=APPROVED, candidate_sha256 matches, manifest_sha256 matches
AuthorizationResult.evidence dict is populated with all verification details in every case
produce_authorization_evidence() returns machine-readable evidence following W3 format
All test cases pass: pytest tests/test_authorization_checker.py shows 100% pass rate
Full W4 test suite passes: pytest tests/test_implementation_approval.py tests/test_approval_endpoint.py tests/test_workflow_transitions.py tests/test_authorization_checker.py -v shows 100% pass rate
Full regression suite passes with same or fewer failures than W3 baseline (467 pass, 13 pre-existing failures)
